## *✨ I'll be watching over you ✨*

_____________________

## 💫 POWERS

For your first and second Power, I would suggest one of the following:

⭐ [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb)

- Excellent option for Round 1, allowing you to consistently heal or boost two teammates at once if used correctly. In every fight, make a habit of swapping between vulnerable allies to keep two targets constantly supported — maximizing your impact and keeping your team in the fight.


⭐ [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) 

- Very strong opening Power that can make it easier to rack up cash early and win team fights. When you activate your Ult with this power, it can effectively create a **3v2 DPS advantage**, with continuous healing and damage boost, helping you secure eliminations and rack up assists. Maximize [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) to heal more and generate your Ultimate quickly. It also makes it much safer to **Resurrect**, since you don't have to stop healing. Don’t hesitate to pull out your Blaster as soon as you press Q!

_________________

## ⚔️ ITEMS

For Mercy, or any other Weapon Healing Support, [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) are the best for maximum healing output. Secondary items should be for survival. br
These would be my choices, in order.

If I only have space left for green items, I usually go for:

#### [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) (💥5%)
- More  [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power)  means more healing.

#### [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) (⏭️5%)
- Healing ticks are quicker the more  [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) you have, therefore, more healing.

#### [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69)
- This can be good for Mercy, since having your Ultimate can help you come back faster to a fight after dying. If you got good with [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb), it's an even better Green item.

#### [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) (🛡️25 Shields)
- The 33% quicker health regeneration perk is what makes this item better than Armored Vest, in my opinion.

#### [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) (🛡️25 Armor)
- Armor has built-in damage reduction, although this is only 25. You can pick this with First Aid Kit in Round 1 to be a little harder to kill.

round_upgrades.notes: More WP means more healing.
More AS means quicker healing ticks, therefore quicker healing.
Can be good since your Ultimate can make it easier to come back to a fight faster after dying. Also good when paired with Crepuscular Circle.
Better than Armored Vest in my opinion, due to the Health Regen perk.

## *✨ Angel at your shoulder! ✨*

In Round 2, you'll want to start stacking [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) to get as much healing output as possible.

This helps you keep your allies alive better, while getting your Ultimate more often, which also means you will be making cash quicker.

Remember, **Mercy heals herself for 40%** of the healing she does with her staff (**60%** with [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1)), so you can keep yourself alive a lot better if you have a higher healing output.

__________________________


## ⚔️ ITEMS

#### [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) (💥5%, ⏭️10%)
- Great $4000 item, giving you 15% total stats. With Mercy, you will be getting the **10%** [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) as long as you are healing. This is almost always on my items list for leftover cash.

#### [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) (💥15%)
#### [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) (💥10%, ⏱️5%)
- Both are great items to pair with [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e).

#### [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) (⏭️10%)
- Another good item to boost your healing if you're lower on cash.

#### [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) (🛡️100+10 Armor)
- If you're getting hurt a lot, this is a good, cheap item, since armor has built-in damage reduction.

#### [Long Distance Wings](item_8b4bafad-c8bc-4c77-bbe7-798b03920c88) (🪽GA)
- Good item on open maps, like Push or Control Point, to be able to reach allies in need from further away, escape dangerous situations easier or come back faster to the fight.

### Extra Cash? (16k)

#### [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) (💥15%)
- You can get this early if you've had an amazing first round. This is a must-have in this build, helping you keeping critical health allies alive better. If you can get this with another [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) item, I would highly suggest it — though if you need survivability, I would wait until Round 3.

####  

**GREEN ITEMS** (Refer to the Round 1 Notes for more details)

- [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) (⏭️)

## 💫 POWERS

You can choose a different power for your playstyle or different matchups. Mercy has a lot of good powers, so feel free to experiment — Though I would suggest [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) and [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) as Round 1 and 3 Powers.

#### Don't forget to maximise [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) to boost your healing output!

⭐ [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb)
- Super strong power that can make it easier to rack up cash early and win team fights. Heal as much as you can to get your Ultimate quickly.

⭐ [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb)
- Great for cash and high support; Make sure to switch between two teammates often enough to heal or boost two people at the same time. If you didn't pick this in Round 1, I would highly suggest picking it now.

⭐ [Renaissance](item_a460f234-6434-4d47-99f9-d4a0b15cd591)
- Great to secure your survival after a **Resurrect*. It pairs perfectly with [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) and can be a gamechanger for many fights.

⭐ [Serenity](item_c6e1c072-ff50-467e-b59f-9506baea10c1)
- If you've having trouble surviving from continuous damage, this is a very good power. As long as you are locked onto an ally with your beam, full HP or not, you will be healed. Focus lower HP allies to heal yourself more.

If you have trouble staying alive, pick Serenity before Renaissance.
